This is the final turn of an openness reading chain. reading_record carries the preceding turns, retained notes, checked excerpts, passage answers and allowances. Judge the exact native subject and every formulation in native.scientific_context.openness_minimum using this record and the evidence delivered here.

Reading units have three kinds. A fulltext is named by version_id, a search_response by source_id, and a record by record_kind and record_id. record_kind is literature_search, reading or problem_statement. Full texts and captured responses may also specify text_sha256 identifying the whole body. Store records were delivered as exact JSON text. The sources list gives one whole-source descriptor per cited artifact and its identities. Verified excerpts and delivered passages contain original source characters with start, end and the span's SHA-256. Unmatched excerpts are unchecked reviewer copies; over_allowance entries deliver no text.

A required unit must have reached earlier reading turns complete, whole or in all its parts, or be delivered complete in this final input. To fit the route limit, this input may withhold bodies already delivered complete in reading turns and then notes of the earliest turns. Each withheld body names its delivering turns; notes_withheld names the turn whose notes are absent. The harness never withholds an excerpt or a passage. The statement, formulations and allowances remain. Do not assume absent bodies or notes remain available in conversation.

Return the native result review described above. If you need a bounded passage before judging and the passage allowance remains, return instead exactly {schema_version:1,stage:"reading",subject_digest,claim_digest,reviewer,excerpts,notes,passage_requests}. Copy the three binding fields from native. notes is a nonempty string of at most 20,000 characters; retain essential earlier conclusions and unresolved issues in these latest notes.

excerpts uses {version_id,text,purpose}, {source_id,text,purpose}, or {record_kind,record_id,text,purpose}, with optional text_sha256 on the first two forms. Preserve material quotations as excerpts. Matching uses per-character NFKC, collapsed whitespace and the first occurrence in the whole stored body. Each excerpt needs at least 20 normalized characters and at most 6,000 original matched characters; the verified-excerpt allowance is 200,000 characters for the chain. Unmatched copies remain explicitly unchecked.

A reading response here must contain at least one passage request: {id,<the same identity fields>,anchor,characters}. IDs are unique within this response. anchor has at least 20 normalized characters; characters is an integer from 1 to 20,000. Copy record anchors from the exact JSON text, including escapes inside strings. A subsequent turn supplies the original text from the first matching anchor, or "not_found" or "over_allowance". Delivered passages have a chain allowance of 100,000 characters. When no passage allowance remains, return the native result review. Missing decisive evidence remains a gap; an excerpt, passage or descriptor does not establish complete-unit delivery.
